screening_detail: Publisher-managed SMHI IFCB archive contains 17731 event-table rows: one dataset_event container, 8865 sampling_event parents, and 8865 sample leaves. Taxon occurrences link to 8864 sample leaves; the one unlinked sample has event-level measurements and an Imaging instrument flag of 'Missing cells', so it remains unknown rather than a negative until provider/QC qualification resolves its meaning. The archive has 121103 machine-classified occurrence rows from 2016-08-10 to 2024-12-15. Exact geometry retains 3212 core and 57844 external-transfer rows. Carbon, biovolume, abundance, classifier identity, F1 score, trophic type, and unidentified-ROI fields are present. Only four calendar years (2016 and 2022-2024) are represented, classifications are machine-predicted, and the imaged size domain is incomplete for total phytoplankton; retain as a Tier B lifeform and temporal-resolution benchmark, not an independent recurrent total-biomass reference. Exact CMEMS overlap remains not assessed; zero denotes unknown under this secondary disposition.
